directive.quote: The hosting providers (Hetzner, Fly Machines, own-box) and the DNS provider (Cloudflare) extend their existing service-connections rows.

preserve: The Hetzner lease behaviour the six unchanged tests in the source pin: one lease owns one server and key, retry reuses it, a foreign relabelled host is never removed, a retained service has no deletion deadline, a lost create answer reconciles only the labelled host, deadline cleanup retries, and paths outside the row's requests are refused before any network call with no credential in errors.
allowed_deltas: Hetzner's paths, bodies and answer paths move from the client into the hetzner service-connections rows (instrument_requests plus rents_a_host); the client sends only those requests.
banned_substitutions: No second provider registry outside parts/service-connections/records.json.
No credential value in any row; credentials by vault name only.

baseline.note: The source test file is unchanged; the client was hetznerLeaseClient in scripts/portable-host-lease.mjs on main.

proof.note: Fake fetch and fake request only; nothing ran against a real account.
